messages.text: Heads up, Q2 compliance certificate came in for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0273}} and the DSCR is 1.08x. Covenant floor on the term loan is 1.20x. That's a breach on a.k.a. a_00561 facility, tested on trailing twelve months.
Thanks Brandi. Is that the borrower's own calc or did you re-run it from the financials they sent?
Re-ran it from the reviewed statements. Their cert said 1.19x because they added back a one-time legal accrual. Credit agreement doesn't permit that add-back, so it's 1.08x on our read.
Cassandra is the RM on this one but she's out until Thursday. I spoke to them last week and they flagged softer receivables. Not surprised, but I didn't expect it to be this far under.
Do we have a cure period? I'm looking at the agreement and section 7.2 says 30 days after notice but I want to confirm there's no equity cure carve-out.
30 days after written notice, yes. No equity cure that I can find. Only a waiver or amendment gets them out of default. I'll pull the exact language into the file.
Let's not send a default notice yet. Brandi, draft a reservation of rights letter first. Lynn, can you get on a call with the borrower tomorrow so we hear their story before anything formal goes out?
Will do. I'll try {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0273}} tonight and email {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0273}} to set a time. Should I loop Risk in before the call?
Yes, ping Lance Peters in credit risk now. They'll want to consider a risk rating downgrade. It's already rated high, so this probably goes to watchlist.
Quick check on exposure: the operating account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00560}} still has decent balances. Do we have setoff rights if this goes sideways?
Yes, setoff is in the security section. But I'd hold off using it. Freezing the operating account right now would likely tip them into a liquidity problem and make things worse.
Agreed. No setoff, no account restrictions without my sign-off. Let's see what they propose first. A fee-bearing waiver with tighter reporting is the likely path.
Left a voicemail and sent the email. I asked for a call tomorrow at 10 or 2. Also reminded them that this is not a default notice, just a request to discuss the certificate.
Reservation of rights draft is in the shared folder. I kept it short: acknowledges receipt, notes the DSCR discrepancy, reserves all rights, no waiver implied. Can someone review?
Reading now. One suggestion: cite the loan on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00561}} explicitly in the reference line so there's no ambiguity about which facility.
Looks good with Heidi's edit. Legal should see it before it goes out. Brandi, send it to them tonight and copy me.
Sent to Legal. I'll also update the covenant tracker and flag the breach for the weekly credit committee agenda.
Update: they called back already. Confirmed a call at 2 tomorrow and said they'd bring a proposal for a waiver plus a revised forecast. I'll share notes right after.
